tools.name: get_metadata_api_billing_document_srv
tools.title: get_metadata_api_billing_document_srv
tools.description:
Get metadata of the OData service with optional filtering to reduce token consumption.
Returns the metadata in XML format, which can be used to discover available entities and their properties.
Call this endpoint every time before you call other tools to ensure understanding of the schema.
Based on the metadata, you can dynamically create an OData request.

Use filtering parameters to get specific metadata sections. Without parameters, this tool returns the complete XML metadata (which might be huge).
Only use the specified enum values for the filtering parameters.

tools.name: batch_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.title: batch_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.description: Execute multiple OData operations in a single batch request using the $batch endpoint. This allows you to combine multiple tool calls into one HTTP request, improving efficiency when performing multiple operations.

tools.name: list_a_billingdocument_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.title: list_A_BillingDocument_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a list of entities from the A_BillingDocument collection in the api_billing_document_srv service. Supports OData query options for filtering, sorting, ranking ($top), skipping ($skip), expanding related entities, counting, selecting specific properties. Only use attributes in the query options that are specified in the metadata. If the structure of the entity is not known, call get_metadata_api_billing_document_srv tool first to get the metadata.

tools.name: get_a_billingdocument_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.title: get_A_BillingDocument_for_api_billing_document_srv
tools.description: Retrieve a single entity by its key from the A_BillingDocument collection in the api_billing_document_srv service. Provide the key property value(s) to identify the specific entity to retrieve. Supports OData query options for selecting specific properties ($select), expanding related entities ($expand). If the structure of the entity is not known, call get_metadata_api_billing_document_srv tool first to get the metadata.
